rank-kiwi.name: Rank Kiwi
rank-kiwi.bestFor: Public content research and creator-relative outlier discovery
rank-kiwi.description: Rank Kiwi is a lightweight, privacy-first browser extension designed for content research and outlier discovery on Instagram and YouTube. It calculates non-skewed median performance baselines directly in the browser, highlighting breakout Reels, Shorts, and long-form videos with one-click exports.
keyCapabilities: Normalized Outlier Score (views/engagement relative to creator median)
On-page sorting across Reels, Instagram posts, YouTube videos, and Shorts
Multi-attribute metric filtering (views, likes, comments, date ranges)
One-click export of video URLs, hooks, captions, and metrics to CSV and JSON
100% client-side privacy with zero account registration or remote cloud logging
rank-kiwi.mainLimitation: Does not schedule or auto-publish social media posts, and cannot access private owned-channel metrics like search traffic attribution, retention drop-off graphs, or YouTube revenue.

pricing.summary: 100% Free forever ($0.00 USD) with unrestricted post analysis on public profiles.

rank-kiwi.bestSuitedTo: Creators, video editors, and social strategists who want to discover viral hooks and outlier formats without paying monthly subscription fees.

instagram-insights.name: Instagram Insights (Meta)
instagram-insights.bestFor: First-party audience demographics and account reach
instagram-insights.description: Instagram Insights is the built-in analytics dashboard provided by Meta for Professional (Creator and Business) accounts. It provides first-party performance telemetry, follower activity patterns, and exact reach counts.
keyCapabilities: Verified audience demographic breakdowns (age, gender, top cities, top countries)
Profile activity metrics (profile visits, link taps, external website clicks)
Accounts reached and accounts engaged segmented by followers vs non-followers
Second-by-second Reels drop-off and average percentage watched graphs
Native integration into Meta Business Suite and Ads Manager
instagram-insights.mainLimitation: Completely restricted to accounts you own. It provides zero visibility into competitor profile metrics, cannot sort public creator feeds, and cannot discover market-wide content outliers.

pricing.summary: 100% Free native feature for all Instagram Creator and Business accounts.

instagram-insights.bestSuitedTo: Account owners and brand managers evaluating their own audience demographics and verifying sponsor reach metrics.

youtube-studio.name: YouTube Studio Analytics
youtube-studio.bestFor: Own-channel retention, click-through rates, and monetization
youtube-studio.description: YouTube Studio Analytics is Google's native analytics platform for creators and channel managers. It provides ground-truth telemetry regarding audience retention, impressions click-through rate (CTR), traffic sources, and AdSense revenue.
keyCapabilities: Exact second-by-second audience retention curves with intro, spike, and dip indicators
Impression Click-Through Rate (CTR) and thumbnail impression funnels
Traffic source attribution (YouTube Search, Suggested Videos, Browse Features, External)
Detailed revenue metrics including estimated earnings, RPM, and playback-based CPM
Advanced Mode multidimensional filtering, side-by-side date comparisons, and CSV export
youtube-studio.mainLimitation: Cannot analyze competitor channels or public video catalogs. It provides zero competitor research tools or external outlier discovery.

pricing.summary: 100% Free native platform for all authenticated YouTube channel owners.

youtube-studio.bestSuitedTo: YouTube creators and editors optimizing their own video retention, thumbnail CTR, and channel revenue.

socialinsider.name: Socialinsider
socialinsider.bestFor: Multi-brand competitive benchmarking and executive reporting
socialinsider.description: Socialinsider is a cloud social media analytics and competitive benchmarking platform designed for digital marketing agencies and enterprise brands. It monitors competitor profiles and generates automated cross-network performance reports.
keyCapabilities: Head-to-head competitor brand benchmarking across 6 major social networks
Automated white-label client PDF and PowerPoint executive presentation exports
Industry engagement rate benchmark indices based on thousands of analyzed brands
Historical content performance tracking and campaign hashtag monitoring
Team collaboration workspaces with multi-client project organization
socialinsider.mainLimitation: High starting price ($82+/month) with no permanent free tier. Lacks client-side on-page browser feed sorting and is not designed for fast video editing hook research.

pricing.summary: Paid subscription starting from $82/month (annual Adapt tier) or $99/month monthly, with a 14-day free trial.

socialinsider.bestSuitedTo: Agencies and corporate marketing teams requiring multi-brand competitor benchmarking and automated executive reporting decks.

metricool.name: Metricool
metricool.bestFor: All-in-one social scheduling, unified inbox, and competitor tracking
metricool.badge: Best for Social Scheduling + Competitor Tracking
metricool.description: Metricool is a comprehensive social media management platform that combines a visual content scheduling calendar, auto-publishing, unified social inbox, and multi-network competitor monitoring into an affordable suite.
keyCapabilities: Visual drag-and-drop social scheduling calendar with multi-network auto-publishing
Public competitor tracking for up to 5 profiles on the free plan and 100+ on paid plans
Unified social inbox for responding to comments and direct messages across networks
Basic first-party account analytics and automated monthly PDF report downloads
Paid advertising campaign tracking across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads
metricool.mainLimitation: Analytics focus on profile-level aggregates and posting schedules rather than video-level outlier detection or creator-relative performance ratios.

pricing.summary: Permanent Free plan (1 brand, 20 posts/mo, 5 competitors). Paid plans start from $20/month (annual Starter) or $22/month monthly.

metricool.bestSuitedTo: Social media managers and small businesses wanting an all-in-one publishing calendar with integrated competitor benchmarking.

viewstats.name: Viewstats
viewstats.bestFor: YouTube historical databases, visual thumbnail search, and channel tracking
viewstats.description: Viewstats is an advanced YouTube analytics platform co-founded by MrBeast. It maintains a multi-year historical video database, tracks subscriber and view milestones, provides visual thumbnail search, and monitors thumbnail A/B tests.
keyCapabilities: Massive multi-year database of historical YouTube video uploads and channel metrics
Visual thumbnail search engine allowing creators to explore successful cover designs
Thumbnail A/B test tracking showing which thumbnails top creators swapped and when
Outlier video alert notifications when monitored channels publish breakout videos
Advanced channel projection modeling and subscriber milestone forecasts
viewstats.mainLimitation: Restricted exclusively to YouTube (no Instagram or short-form cross-network coverage), and Pro/Business plans require substantial monthly investments.

pricing.summary: Free basic channel lookup. Pro tier with dynamic pricing; Business starting at $249/month.

viewstats.bestSuitedTo: Dedicated YouTube creators, video strategists, and thumbnail designers analyzing long-term platform trends and packaging.

vidiq.name: vidIQ
vidiq.bestFor: YouTube search keyword research, tag optimization, and competitor tracking
vidiq.badge: Best for YouTube SEO & Keyword Research
vidiq.description: vidIQ is a YouTube creator growth tool and browser extension focusing on search engine optimization, keyword volume discovery, tag suggestions, and daily AI-assisted video topic ideas.
keyCapabilities: In-depth YouTube search keyword tool showing monthly search volume and competition scores
Browser extension inspecting tags, metadata, and VPH (Views Per Hour) on any YouTube video
Daily personalized video topic recommendations based on channel niche and historical data
Competitor channel tracking and real-time email alerts for breakout competitor uploads
AI-assisted title generators, description builders, and thumbnail view predictors
vidiq.mainLimitation: YouTube only (no Instagram or TikTok coverage), and is heavily tuned toward search keyword discovery rather than short-form outlier hook analysis.

pricing.summary: Free basic browser extension. Paid Pro starts from $10/month; Boost from $49/month.

vidiq.bestSuitedTo: YouTube creators producing search-focused content, tutorials, and evergreen videos needing tag and keyword guidance.

sort-feed.name: Sort Feed
sort-feed.bestFor: Multi-platform short-form feed sorting and speech-to-text audio transcription
sort-feed.description: Sort Feed is a browser extension that allows users to sort feeds across Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and Facebook. It includes outlier detection and cloud-based speech-to-text transcription for video dialogue.
keyCapabilities: Cross-network sorting across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook feeds
Automated speech-to-text audio transcription on Pro (500 minutes/month)
Outlier Score calculations on visible creator post feeds
Custom date filtering and post sample depth up to 1,000 posts on Pro
Data export and media download functionality
sort-feed.mainLimitation: Free tier is capped at the latest 25 posts or 1 week of content. Accessing 1,000 posts and audio transcription requires a paid Pro subscription ($10–$15/mo).

pricing.summary: Free plan capped at 25 posts / 1 week. Pro costs $10/month billed annually ($120/yr) or $15/month monthly.

sort-feed.bestSuitedTo: Marketers who require short-form research across TikTok and Facebook alongside automated video speech-to-text transcription.

social-blade.name: Social Blade
social-blade.bestFor: High-level historical follower and subscriber growth tracking
social-blade.description: Social Blade is a public statistical database tracking channel and profile milestones across major digital networks. It provides historical subscriber charts, estimated earnings ranges, and account rank classifications.
keyCapabilities: Historical day-by-day follower and subscriber growth charts dating back years
Global rank classifications by total subscribers, views, and country
Estimated YouTube AdSense revenue ranges based on broad platform CPM models
Multi-network profile lookup across Twitch, YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok
Future growth projection models based on recent 30-day velocity
social-blade.mainLimitation: Provides macro account-level metrics only; zero individual post/Reels sorting, no video hook analysis, and no normalized outlier detection.

pricing.summary: Free public search (ad-supported). Paid premium memberships start from $3.99/month (Bronze) to $39.99/month (Gold).

social-blade.bestSuitedTo: Researchers, journalists, and brand sponsors checking macro account legitimacy, follower trajectories, and channel size milestones.

buzzsumo.name: BuzzSumo
buzzsumo.bestFor: Web article sharing research, journalist outreach, and PR monitoring
buzzsumo.badge: Best for Cross-Web Viral Content Discovery
buzzsumo.description: BuzzSumo is a content marketing intelligence and PR monitoring platform that indexes web articles and social shares to identify viral news topics, trending articles, and top social publishers.
keyCapabilities: Cross-web search engine for top-shared articles, blog posts, and news stories
Author and journalist search with media outreach contact details
Brand and topic monitoring with real-time PR alert notifications
Historical content trend analysis spanning up to 5 years of web data
Facebook and YouTube viral content topic discovery
buzzsumo.mainLimitation: Enterprise PR and journalism focus with a high starting price ($199+/mo). Lacks Instagram Reels extraction and creator-relative video outlier detection.

pricing.summary: Starting from $199/month (Basic plan, billed annually) with a 30-day free trial available.

buzzsumo.bestSuitedTo: PR agencies, content marketers, and media publications researching cross-web viral trends and pitch angles.

sprout-social.name: Sprout Social
sprout-social.bestFor: Enterprise social listening, CRM customer care, and corporate team workflows
sprout-social.badge: Best for Enterprise Social Listening & Care
sprout-social.description: Sprout Social is an enterprise-grade social media management, social listening, and customer care platform. It provides large corporate marketing organizations with unified customer support inboxes, listening streams, and compliance tools.
keyCapabilities: Enterprise social listening streams tracking brand mentions, sentiment, and share of voice
Unified Smart Inbox with CRM ticketing integration and customer history
Multi-tier approval workflows and team collaboration permission controls
Comprehensive cross-network publishing calendar with asset library management
Audit-ready executive reporting and paid social advertising attribution
sprout-social.mainLimitation: Prohibitive pricing for individual creators and video editors ($199 to $399 per user per month). Not built for fast creator ideation or video hook discovery.

pricing.summary: Standard plan starts at $199/seat/month; Professional at $299/seat/month; Advanced at $399/seat/month, with a 30-day trial.

sprout-social.bestSuitedTo: Mid-market and enterprise marketing departments needing social listening, corporate compliance, and team customer service inboxes.

buffer.name: Buffer
buffer.bestFor: Clean, focused social media scheduling and queue management
buffer.description: Buffer is an intuitive social media publishing and scheduling tool that helps creators, solopreneurs, and small teams draft, schedule, and queue posts across modern social networks.
keyCapabilities: Clean, distraction-free visual publishing calendar and automated queue
Support for Instagram Reels, carousels, stories, and YouTube Shorts auto-publishing
Start Page feature providing customizable link-in-bio mobile landing pages
Basic post-publishing engagement analytics and best-time-to-post recommendations
Affordable per-channel pricing with an accessible permanent free tier
buffer.mainLimitation: Strictly a publishing and scheduling tool; does not analyze competitor feeds, compute creator-relative benchmarks, or detect viral outliers.

pricing.summary: Permanent Free plan for up to 3 channels (10 scheduled posts/channel). Essentials plan starts from $6/month per channel.

buffer.bestSuitedTo: Creators, freelancers, and small businesses looking for an easy, affordable way to plan and automate their social posting schedule.
